items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury. Earlier optimistic GTD reports held; McVay called it minor.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; high ranking signal holds
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in favorable spot; Davante Adams already OUT boosts share

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins. Unlikely earlier due to quad; not full participant. Misses fourth straight.
items.implication: Sit Hall; clear lead role elsewhere in Jets backfield
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity to backups (Braelon Allen lead expected); reverse any limited-share assumptions

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again. Confirmed in ETR Sunday summary and multiple reports.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rush upside shift; fade Lamar completely
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Ravens skill players under Huntley; monitor Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely usage

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Major hit to PHI pass game; boost remaining pieces if Saquon plays
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route/target share for other Eagles pass-catchers

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room (thigh) then returned; was Q to return mid-game.
items.implication: Monitor for limitations but cleared to continue

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (Q) for MNF vs Cowboys after hamstring; full practice signals positive. DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
items.implication: Start Saquon if active; Eagles pass game thinned
items.opportunity: Saquon volume secure; elevated targets/routes for remaining WRs/TE (Goedert) with Smith/Wicks out

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and ACTIVE for Packers vs Lions after exempt list.
items.implication: Return to RB role; monitor snap share post-layoff
items.opportunity: Lead back opportunity but workload questions after absence

items.text: ETR weekend summary: OUT Mike Evans/Deebo/Davante Adams/Rashee Rice/Jeremiyah Love/David Montgomery/Emeka Egbuka/Tyler Warren etc.; multiple INs including Jacobs/Mason/Dell/Kirk.
items.implication: Clear sit for OUTs; start confirmed INs with role notes
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in SF (CMC), LAR (Puka), GB (Jacobs), HOU (Dell), etc.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; delivered 124 yards on 17 carries + TD.
Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. (Activated/IN per ETR).
Lamar, Puka, Breece statuses crucial for DFS main slate. Projections fully updated on latest news including outs and actives. Sneaky scratches: Egbuka, Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Injury volatility drives slate; updated projections reflect
items.implication: Adjust lineups/projections immediately on confirmed statuses
items.opportunity: Value shifts to confirmed actives and beneficiaries of outs

items.text: Kenneth Walker III on pace for 2,261 rush yards (Dickerson record); Jaxon Smith-Njigba on pace 2,032 rec yards (Megatron record). Walker already outpaces all SEA RBs combined.
Tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo out) despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR claims; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: WR injuries + CMC comment/smile; rare buy-in
items.implication: Potential receiving upside boost for CMC
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets in slot if true; 49ers WR outs create vacuum

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (WR10) vs CHI for usage and matchup; Bears soft vs WRs.
Loves Tucker Kraft (TE6) @ DET; Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed).
items.opportunity: Red-zone/goal-line + volume vs soft TE D

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren (@NO RB9), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB RB10), Bucky Irving (@CAR RB12) for workloads in friendly matchups.
Hates Josh Jacobs (@DET RB18) due to workload questions after long layoff.
Hates Rome Odunze (vs NE, shadowed by Gonzalez) and Josh Downs (@MIN); tough matchups/usage.
